text:
Sarah (product): Heads-up — Acme Health wants a private beta for embeddings next month. They need 2k-dim vectors, throughput ~800 qps, and HIPAA-ish controls. Can we scope SLA + model choice + response format?
Mike (eng-platform): 800 qps is big for 2048 dims. We should decide batching ceiling + per-tenant concurrency. Do they need streaming responses?
Liz (customer-success): Acme will do bulk indexing from SFTP nightly + real-time lookups during day. Streaming not critical for indexing, but lookup latency target is <60ms P95.
Anya (eng-ml): For 2048 we should use the quantized .q4f16 variant we validated — much cheaper but check recall on their eval set. Also need to pick embedding model family: semantic-embed vs universal-sparse.
Juan (devex): They'll want simple response metadata for debugging: model, dims, request_id, billing_units. Prefer named fields over positional arrays.
Sarah (product): OK priorities: 1) SLA for lookups (<60ms P95), 2) batch upload throughput (>=800 qps sustained for ingest), 3) response format that includes metadata. Any blockers?
Mike (eng-platform): Main tradeoffs: batching size vs latency. Suggest two modes: 
- lookup: max_batch_size=32, target latency SLO 60ms P95
- bulk_index: max_batch_size=1024 (or chunked streaming) for throughput.
We also need per-tenant throttles to protect host.
Anya (eng-ml): Agreed. Also propose an auto-fallback: if dedicated 2048 node saturated, route lookups to a lower-dim 1024 variant with a deterministic downsampling mapping + warning header so app can degrade gracefully. We should run evaluation to estimate quality drop.
Liz (customer-success): Acme will accept degraded dims for read path if we include a compatibility score per vector. They want to know when fallback happened.
Juan (devex): About response format: propose JSON like:

```
{
  "vector": [0.12, -0.03, ...],
  "meta": {
    "model": "rwd-embed-2048-q4f16",
    "dims": 2048,
    "request_id": "req_...",
    "fallback": "none",
    "billing_units": 1.23
  }
}
```

That keeps vector + structured meta.
Mike (eng-platform): Implementation notes: KV cache + prefix caching will help read latency for repeated queries. For 2048 we need to ensure memory budget on inference nodes: per-node active KV cache limit. Also batching for bulk_index should bypass KV cache.
Anya (eng-ml): Test matrix: run recall vs baseline on Acme's eval set across (2048-full, 2048-quant, 1024). Record embedding cosine drift and downstream retrieval precision@10. We need thresholds for acceptable fallback.
Sarah (product): What are launch criteria for beta? My suggestion:
- quality: retrieval p@10 drop <= 3% vs 2048-full on eval
- latency: lookup P95 <= 60ms at 95th percentile of expected traffic
- stability: no more than 1 outage >5m in beta window
- observability: per-tenant metrics (latency, fallback rate, billing)
Anyone disagree?
Mike (eng-platform): Agree but add: autoscale burst to handle spike -> 1500 qps for 60s without hard throttle. Also require rate-limiter rules configurable per-tenant.
Liz (customer-success): Acme will sign if we provide an SLA doc and a fallback policy that can be toggled. Also need data residency proof for nightly uploads.
Juan (devex): SDK changes: add `meta=true` param to include meta block; add `prefer_dims=[2048,1024]` to request signature so app can express preference. Backwards compat by default to minimal response.
Anya (eng-ml): One more: quantify cost impact. 2048 quantized is ~2.2x cost of 1024 per token for inference; need to reflect in billing_units. We'll provide cost multiplier table in docs.
Sarah (product): Action items:
- Anya: run eval matrix and publish numbers (due in 4 business days)
- Mike: prototype per-tenant throttle + fallback route, note memory sizing (due EOW)
- Juan: sketch SDK fields + example payload (due +3 days)
- Liz: collect Acme legal/data residency checklist and confirm acceptance for fallback (due +2 days)
- Sarah: draft beta SLA + launch checklist (due +5 days)

Mike (eng-platform): Quick config example for platform team (will use in PR):

```
{
  "endpoint": "embed-acme-prod",
  "modes": {
    "lookup": {"max_batch": 32, "p95_latency_ms": 60},
    "bulk_index": {"max_batch": 1024, "stream_chunk_size": 256}
  },
  "fallbacks": [{"from_dims":2048, "to_dims":1024, "policy":"route-if-queue>500ms"}],
  "per_tenant_limits": {"qps": 1000, "burst":1500}
}
```

Sarah (product): Great. Also want a small UX note: when fallback happens include `warning` header and metric so product can surface in app.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline: draft config detected in branch `engml/emb-beta-acme` — run CI and perf harness.
Mike (eng-platform): I'll kick off a small perf run on the quant model after lunch and share numbers in this thread. If numbers look good we can commit to the 2048-quant default for beta.
Anya (eng-ml): I'll attach eval results and a small notebook with downsampling mapping once ready.
Liz (customer-success): Thanks — I'll coordinate onboarding kickoff with Acme once we have SLA draft.
Sarah (product): Thanks team — we'll reconvene after the evaluation results.
